name: Toyotomi (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Toyotomi town emblem in white and green: concentric white rings enclosing a stylised character beneath a green leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Toyotomi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 September 1968; the emblem dates from 1 October 1940.

features.role: Toyotomi town emblem — concentric white rings enclosing a stylised character beneath a green leaf
